svg.aria-label: Role, schema, then a stateless server: 1. Role: The litellm-pgvector-db Kustomization creates the litellm_pgvector role and database on the shared postgres-18 cluster. Removing it keeps the data. 2. Schema: A Job runs schema.sql as the superuser, creates the vector extension, then switches to the app role so the app owns its tables. 3. Secrets: Two ExternalSecrets feed the server its own connection string and API key, and the Job its superuser login. The server never sees the superuser password. 4. Serve: The stateless server answers OpenAI-style vector-store calls on port 8000. It has a ClusterIP Service and no HTTPRoute, so only LiteLLM reaches it. 5. Embed: The server embeds search queries with qwen3-embedding-8b through LiteLLM, requested at 2000 dimensions, and searches the stored vectors with an HNSW cosine index.
